list-recordings.description: List the recordings that run now, across every session.

returns.name: recordings
returns.description: One entry per recording: path, window, started_at.

mark-recording.description: Write a marker (an m event) into a pane's recording at the current time, so a player can jump to the moment.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.

params.name: label
params.description: The marker's label, one line of at most 200 bytes.

returns.name: window
returns.description: The id of the pane recorded.

record-pane.description: Record a pane to an asciicast v2 file (.cast) that asciinema, agg and reel play. The first event paints the screen the pane shows now, its history included; then every output chunk and resize is an event at its real time. Input is not recorded. The recording runs until stop-recording, duration_ms, max_bytes or the pane's end. The file holds everything the pane prints while it runs.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.

params.name: out
params.description: The path of the file to write, absolute or starting with ~, made with mode 0600. Over a link, held to the file verbs' write rules.

params.name: overwrite
params.description: Replace out when it exists. Without it, an existing file is refused with file_exists.

params.name: duration_ms
params.description: Stop after this long. 0 records until stopped.

params.name: max_bytes
params.description: Stop when the file reaches this size, with a size limit marker. Between 4096 and 1073741824.

params.name: title
params.description: The title the header carries, which players show.

returns.name: window
returns.description: The id of the pane recorded.

returns.name: width
returns.description: The pane's width when the recording started, the header's width.

returns.name: height
returns.description: The pane's height when the recording started, the header's height.

returns.name: started_at
returns.description: When the recording started, RFC 3339 in UTC.

stop-recording.description: Stop a pane's recording. Answers once the file is closed.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.

returns.name: window
returns.description: The id of the pane recorded.

returns.name: events
returns.description: How many events the file holds, the snapshot included.

returns.name: seconds
returns.description: The time of the last event.

returns.name: reason
returns.description: Why the recording ended: stopped here, or what ended it first.

returns.name: started_at
returns.description: When the recording started, RFC 3339 in UTC.
